question: A support message calls the change complete. Which is complete, the code fix or the customer rollout, and what remains unfinished?

claims.text: The PAY-102 code fix is complete; its code completion does not itself approve general customer release.

supports.quote: PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.

claims.text: PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval, and general availability was not approved.

supports.quote: Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.

claims.text: The customer rollout is not complete: payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot, general availability is not approved, and no general release date is confirmed.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
Payment-retry remains a controlled pilot. No GA date is confirmed; use the capability page and release approval.
